Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Internal Audit team helps Robinhood meet a complex set of global regulations for crypto-assets and payment services. Our mission is to give the Board of Directors, its Committees and company leadership independent, objective and timely assurance that our governance, risk management and internal controls work as intended, so we can spot new risks early and keep strengthening our control environment!

As Internal Audit Manager, you will lead and carry out audits of Operations, Compliance and Technology across our crypto business, in line with the Internal Audit plan. You will work with Internal Audit leadership to identify risks, document and test controls, and recommend improvements, and you will help share risk information between the regulated entities, Robinhood Markets (RHM) leadership and the Board.

This role is based in our Luxembourg office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Plan and run audits of Operations, Compliance and Technology processes in our crypto business, from scoping through final reporting, in line with the Internal Audit plan.
  • Perform walkthroughs, control testing and substantive testing, and prepare work papers, flowcharts, narratives and risk and control matrices (RCMs) that document your procedures, findings and conclusions.
  • Write clear audit findings that state the issue, its root cause and its business impact, and agree on recommendations with the teams you audit and with leadership.
  • Build RCMs for new audit areas, focusing on the controls that best reduce the highest risks, and assess whether policies, procedures and systems are adequate and efficient.
  • Work with Business, Risk, Compliance, Legal and Technology partners to understand their processes, solve problems and recommend process improvements, while managing several audits and ad hoc requests at once.

What you bring

  • 7+ years of external or internal audit experience at a company that provides financial products or services, including evaluating internal controls or compliance programs.
  • Experience assessing the design and effectiveness of controls at a crypto exchange, market maker, custody provider, broker-dealer or similar financial institution, and working knowledge of crypto-asset regulations. Broker-dealer regulation knowledge is a plus.
  • Experience supporting regulatory examinations, including preparing for them and responding to regulator questions and findings.
  • A bachelor's degree in Audit, Finance, Operations or Technology, or equivalent practical experience. Certifications such as Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), or crypto and brokerage certifications, are a plus.
  • Proficiency in written and spoken English, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects on time in a fast-changing, regulated, international setting. Occasional travel is required.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, and bonus programs
  • Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.
  • Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

Alpaca Japan is the Japanese subsidiary of a U.S.-based fintech company and is registered as a Type I Financial Instruments Business Operator. We provide API-based securities trading infrastructure and support financial institutions offering U.S. stock trading through order routing to our U.S. broker-dealer group company, with the upcoming plan to add Japanese equities. We also provide account opening and management services for Financial Instruments Intermediary businesses. To support our rapidly growing business in Japan, we are hiring a Compliance Associate.

In this role, you will primarily handle compliance work — including support for regulatory filings and reports, maintaining internal policies and compliance operations, AML/customer-management related work, and monitoring of Financial Instruments Intermediary businesses. We are looking for someone who enjoys identifying challenges, proactively driving improvements, and collaborating with colleagues across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support regulatory filings, reports, and communications with the Financial Services Agency (FSA), Kanto Regional Finance Bureau, the Japan Securities Dealers Association (JSDA), and other regulatory authorities.
  • Support and improve internal compliance operations and related processes.
  • Maintain and update internal policies, procedures, and operational manuals.
  • Assist in regulatory and risk assessments for new products, services, and business processes.
  • Coordinate internal responses and regulatory reporting for incidents such as system failures.
  • Perform AML/CFT, customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and other compliance-related operational tasks.
  • Collaborate with internal departments and global group companies on compliance and operational initiatives.
  • Support internal and external audits and follow-up remediation projects.
  • Assist with the oversight and monitoring of Financial Instruments Intermediary businesses.

Qualifications (required):

  • Native-level Japanese proficiency, including reading, writing, and speaking for compliance work (e.g., regulatory filings, policies, internal documentation, and discussions with internal stakeholders and regulators).
  • Conversational English (able to follow company-wide communications such as all-hands, announcements, and training).
  • At least 3 years of experience in compliance or related control function at a financial institution in Japan.
  • A proactive mindset with the ability to work collaboratively across teams, including global group company members.

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. You may work on a wide variety of critical business areas within Core Infrastructure. We’re the home for Stripe's critical tier0 infrastructure systems (Compute, Networking, DocumentDB, Distributed Caching and High assurance engineering). We build the foundational platform for Stripe products and services to allow them to operate at scale. We drive reliability, availability, efficiency and scalability of these systems.

  • Collaborating with senior leadership to define and execute strategic initiatives for Stripe's core infrastructure.

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Kubernetes).

  • Experience in scaling infrastructure platforms to handle millions of requests per second (RPS).
  • Track record of successful cross-functional project leadership.
  • Familiarity with programming languages commonly used in infrastructure, such as Go, Ruby, or Java.
